title: Estimation & Proposal Engineer – Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I)
description:
\*Company:\* Nave Industries Private Limited

\*Location:\* West Bengal \| PAN India Operations

Nave Industries Private Limited is looking for an experienced professional to develop and manage our subcontractor network for \*Electrical \& Instrumentation (E\&I) Projects across India\*.

\*Key Responsibilities:\*

\- Identify and onboard new E\&I subcontractors across India

\- Develop a strong location\-wise subcontractor/vendor network

\- Verify contractor capability, manpower strength, tools, statutory documents and previous experience

\- Float work enquiries/RFQs and collect subcontractor quotations

\- Rate analysis, negotiation and finalization

\- Prepare subcontractor work scope and coordinate work orders

\- Mobilize subcontractors and manpower as per project requirements

\- Coordinate with clients, Project Managers and site teams

\- Monitor subcontractor work progress, quality, safety and timelines

\- Resolve site execution and manpower\-related issues

\- Verify subcontractor measurements, work completion and bills

\- Ensure projects are completed within approved cost and schedule

\- Maintain subcontractor performance records and develop alternative contractors for critical locations

\*Preferred Experience:\*

\- Diploma/B.E./B.Tech – Electrical / E\&I / Instrumentation

\- 3–5 years of experience in industrial Electrical \& Instrumentation projects

\- Strong network of E\&I contractors/subcontractors preferred

\- Experience in industrial plants, factories and project sites

\- Knowledge of cable laying, termination, cable tray, panels, earthing, instrumentation, field instruments, SS tubing, control wiring, commissioning etc.

\- Strong negotiation and contractor\-management skills

\- Willing to travel across India

\*Key Requirement:\*

The candidate should be capable of taking a project/service requirement, arranging the right subcontractor and coordinating the complete execution until successful handover.

Work Location: In person

title: RF Engineer
description:
About the Role  

We are looking for an RF Engineer to join a technology\-driven engineering team working on advanced radar, RF, communication and sensing systems.  

The position offers an opportunity to work across RF circuit design, simulation, PCB development, testing and validation.  

Key Responsibilities  

Design and simulate RF circuits including:  

Power Amplifiers (PA)  

Low Noise Amplifiers (LNA)  

Mixers  

Filters  

RF Switches  

Couplers  

Develop RF front\-end and mixed\-signal subsystems.  

Perform impedance matching and S\-parameter analysis.  

Design and review RF PCB layouts and associated circuitry.  

Use tools such as ADS, HFSS and KiCad for RF circuit and PCB design.  

Conduct laboratory testing and validation of RF designs.  

Work with instruments including:  

Vector Network Analyzer (VNA)  

Spectrum Analyzer  

Power Meter  

Oscilloscope  

Analyze test results and troubleshoot RF performance issues.  

Collaborate with PCB, embedded, mechanical and systems engineering teams.  

Support prototype development and design iterations.  

Required Qualifications  

M.Tech / M.E. / PhD in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, RF/Microwave Engineering or a related discipline.  

2\-7 years of relevant experience in RF design and development.  

Strong understanding of:  

Electromagnetic theory  

RF circuits  

Transmission lines  

Impedance matching  

S\-parameters  

Practical experience with RF design, simulation and testing.  

Ability to interpret technical specifications, schematics and test results.  

Preferred Skills  

Experience with RF front\-end design.  

Hands\-on experience with ADS, HFSS or similar RF simulation tools.  

Experience in RF PCB design and prototype development.  

Exposure to radar, communication, microwave or sensing systems.  

What You Can Expect  

Opportunity to work on advanced radar and RF technology.  

Exposure to end\-to\-end RF product development.  

Hands\-on access to RF design and measurement activities.  

Collaborative engineering and R\&D environment.  

Strong learning and career\-development opportunities.

title: Job Posting Title MS Engineer VC Support- L1
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  

As a Collaboration Managed Services Engineer (L1\) at NTT DATA, you will be the go\-to person for ensuring our clients' Collaboration, Contact Centre and Voice systems stay up and running. Your main focus will be on providing first\-line support by monitoring private and public cloud infrastructure, identifying problems early, and resolving technical incidents efficiently. You'll play a crucial role in ensuring we meet our service level agreements and deliver an excellent client experience.  

  

Throughout the day you’ll be monitoring client infrastructure for any issues and proactively addressing them before they escalate. If incidents occur, you'll investigate and get to the root cause swiftly to restore services. Your tasks will also include executing approved maintenance activities like patching and configuration changes and providing telephonic or chat support to clients when needed.  

  

Your role doesn't stop at issue resolution; you'll also be identifying opportunities to optimize work processes and reduce incidents. Whether it's updating existing knowledge articles, creating new ones, or finding ways to automate routine tasks, you'll actively contribute to enhancing service delivery. Your ability to adapt to changing circumstances and keep a positive outlook will be key to your success.  

  

Effective communication is essential in this role. You'll collaborate across different cultures and social groups, plan activities comprehensively, and ensure smooth handovers during shift changes. Your commitment to placing clients at the forefront of all interactions will help create a positive client experience throughout their journey with us.  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:*** Basic troubleshooting skills and knowledge in network, voice, collaboration, and contact centre services.
* The ability to triage client cases effectively, ensuring that severity and impact is accurate as well as key information is documented in the case.
* Active listening techniques to confirm understanding and gather relevant information.
* Strong communication skills, able to work across different cultures and social groups.
* Flexibility and adaptability in changing circumstances.
* Positive outlook and resilience under pressure.
* Commitment to creating a positive client experience by understanding their requirements and keeping them clearly updated on progress of their case.
* Willingness to put in extra hours when necessary.
* Diploma, bachelor's degree, or relevant qualification in Information Technology or Computing (or equivalent experience).
* Relevant partner Certifications are also desirable.

title: Instrumentation Engineer
description:
Key Responsibilities

* **Field Instrument Maintenance:** Calibrate and service pressure, flow, level, and temperature transmitters, smart control valves, and motor\-operated valves (MOV) BSS,ZSS,CBS \& Others Field Instrument.
* **Specialized CHP Systems:** Maintain Conveyor belt Safety System, Belt Scale, Silo System, Stacker, Tripercar, Coke Crusher etc.
* **DCS and PLC Operation:** Troubleshoot Distributed Control System (DCS) and Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) logic, I/O modules, and communication networks running conveyor lines, stacker\-reclaimers, Wagon Loader, Truck Loading System, and crushers.
* **Preventive \& Breakdown Maintenance:** Execute routine Preventive Maintenance (PM) schedules, attend to emergency breakdowns, and complete root\-cause analysis (RCA) for equipment failures.
* **Safety \& Compliance:** Enforce Permit to Work (PTW) rules, apply Lock\-Out/Tag\-Out/Try\-Out (LoToTo) protocols, and follow safety norms in heavy industrial zones.
* **Spares \& Documentation:** Track spare parts using inventory platforms like SAP/CMMS and update instrument loops, P\&IDs, and shift logs.

Requirements \& Qualifications

* **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree (B.E./B.Tech) or Diploma in Instrumentation, Electronics \& Instrumentation, or Control \& Instrumentation Engineering.
* **Experience:** 4 to 8 years of hands\-on plant experience in Operation \& Maintenance (O\&M) of bulk material handling or thermal power plant CHP environments.
* **Core Skills:** Strong knowledge of PLC/DCS platforms (e.g., Yokogawa, Emerson, ABB), loop calibration, industrial networks, and asset management systems like SAP.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

title: Principal Mining Engineer
description:
**About us**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.


**Purpose:**  

We are currently recruiting for a Principal Mining Engineer. Our team includes world class experts and dynamic go\-getters. This is a full\-time position based in Oakville or Markham, Ontario to support the delivery of successful projects and programs with the Worley Canadian Mining Team. The successful candidates will focus on front\-end solutions and will support of Worley’s engineering projects both locally and globally.
  

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Provide technical and consulting services to mining clients.
* Act as Mining lead, Project Manager, Project Engineer on EPCM and DE and Project Delivery scope/projects.
* Providing input into Business Development strategy and expand professional network.
* Leading, managing and directing technical and engineering work on PEA, PFS, and FS technical studies.
* Support and work on technical and engineering execution of mining projects.
* Support in the maintenance of client relations.
* Site visits and work on sites as required.

**Services will include:**

* Mine planning and design.
* Mining method selection.
* Mine optimization.
* Cost estimates (CAPEX and OPEX)
* Equipment selection.
* Project and study management.
* Due diligence and technical audits.
* Peer reviews.

**What you will bring:**  

**Technical and Industry Experience:**

* Extensive, senior level knowledge and experience in underground consulting and operational excellence
* In\-depth knowledge of Deswik, Studio 5 D planner and other mining industry approved software .
* Experience and strong familiarity with NI43\-101 and/ or JORC compliant studies highly regarded.
* Willingness to travel.
* Proven ability to collaborate in multi\-functional teams.

**Education – Qualifications, Accreditation, Training:**

**Required:**

* Degree in Engineering.
* PEng valid in Ontario, or ability to obtain.

*For applicants based in the province of Ontario, the salary range is $149,295 to $204,914 CAD.*  

*Application of the pay band: Variation in salary is determined by factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, relevant years of experience, geographic location, internal pay equity, and prevailing market conditions for the specific role.*  

  

*Please note: No agency representation or submissions will be recognized for this vacancy.*  

  

*Worley is committed to providing a fair and equitable hiring process for all applicants. As part of this commitment, Worley will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process. If you require any accommodations or assistance, please contact us at:* *TA.AMERICAS@worley.com*

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.


And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.


And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.
